incidents.title: Synchronisation incidents
incidents.hint: An invoice or credit note “left as a draft” was not issued because its total did not match the shop’s. Fix the stated cause, then set the order back to “completed”: the bridge will pick the document up where it left it.

operation.order.credit.blocked: Credit note left as a draft

autoValidate.guard: In every case, an invoice whose total does not match the order is never issued: it stays a draft, with the reason, and the incident appears below.

sync.done: Catalogue synchronised: {{imported}} product(s) imported, {{exported}} item(s) published, {{stocks}} stock level(s) initialised.

taxes.stale: {{count}} rate(s) once written by AMS Studio are no longer in the reference table, and remain active in the shop. AMS Studio never deletes a tax line: remove them from WooCommerce → Settings → Tax if you no longer want them.

aboutSettings.title: About
aboutSettings.body: Everything this plugin carries is installed: no feature is capped, time-limited or tied to a key. Your data stays in your own database and is sent nowhere.
aboutSettings.librariesBody: Producing an invoice as a PDF needs an HTML-to-PDF engine, and WordPress has none. These libraries travel with the code, unmodified, each with its own licence file in its directory.

stripeSettings.activeDescription: Your customers can pay their invoices by card from the link they receive by email.
stripeSettings.inactiveDescription: Until the keys are filled in and the switch is on, the public page of an invoice shows no payment button.
stripeSettings.intro: Once these keys are filled in, every invoice sent by email offers your customer a “Pay this invoice” button. Payment happens at Stripe: no card number ever passes through this ERP.
stripeSettings.loadError: The payment settings could not be read.
stripeSettings.publishableKeyHelp: Starts with “pk_”. It is not secret.
stripeSettings.saveError: The settings could not be saved.
stripeSettings.secretKeyHelp: Starts with “sk_”. Leave the stars in place to keep the key already saved.
stripeSettings.title: Online payment (Stripe)
stripeSettings.webhookCardDescription: It is this call from Stripe that settles the invoice after payment. Create a webhook in Stripe (Developers → Webhooks) on the address below, then copy the signing secret it gives you here.
stripeSettings.webhookCopyError: The address could not be copied; select it by hand.
stripeSettings.webhookSecretHelp: Starts with “whsec_”. Stripe gives it to you when the webhook is created; without it, payments will not be recorded.
